# Spinach function authors

*Generated by `porting/tools/gen_spinach_authors.py` from `porting/spinach_authors.json`; do not edit.*

Spynach is a translation of [Spinach](https://spindynamics.org) 2.13. Each Spinach function lists its authors at the end of its header, by email address. This page gives them by name, taken from the [Spinach developer team](https://spindynamics.org/wiki/index.php?title=Spinach_developer_team) page, for every Spynach function that translates or derives from a Spinach function; the same lines are in the docstrings (`help(spynach.propagator)`). Function names are Spinach's, so that scripts map line by line, and are not changed to carry authors. A header address that cannot be matched to a name on that page is counted but not named.

How a Spynach function relates to its original:

- **port**: a translation of the Spinach function of that name;
- **derived**: translated from part of a Spinach file, or a different implementation of what it computes;
- **new**: no Spinach counterpart; any authors listed wrote the algorithm it implements.

Functions of Spynach with no Spinach counterpart at all are listed with a dash. The translation was done by reading the Spinach sources; the licence notice is in [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE).
